# Code of Conduct

Storyboard Studio is a small, local-first open-source project. We want its
issues, discussions, and pull requests to stay useful and welcoming.

## Our standard

Participants are expected to be respectful, specific, and collaborative. Give
feedback about the work rather than the person, assume good intent while
staying accountable for impact, and protect private presentation content and
credentials. Harassment, discrimination, threats, doxxing, sexualised
attention, and deliberate disruption are not acceptable.

## Maintainer response

The maintainer may edit, close, or decline contributions that do not meet this
standard or the project contract. Security reports must follow `SECURITY.md`
and must not be posted publicly.

## Reporting

For conduct concerns, contact the repository owner privately through the email
listed in the GitHub profile. Include links or context when safe to do so. Do
not attach confidential decks, API keys, or personal data.
